name: inspira-animated-tooltip
title: Animated Tooltip
description: A row of overlapping circular portraits with white rings. Hovering a face springs a black tooltip above it with the person's name and role, tilting and sliding as the pointer moves sideways.
use: A compact team or contributor row should reveal each person's name and role without leaving the page.
avoid: Names appear on mouse hover only, so touch and keyboard users never see who anyone is.
a11y: Each photo has alt text, but the hover target is a plain div with no tab stop, so keyboard users cannot open the tooltip. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Five small round portraits overlap left to right, each ringed in thick white, on a dark stage. A hovered face lifts a small black rounded card above it holding a bold white name, a dimmer role line and a thin green-to-blue gradient edge.
behaves: Entering a face hides the others' cards and springs its own up from below. Moving the cursor across the face rotates and shifts the card, and leaving drops it away again.
customise: items takes an id, name, designation and image per person; the tilt strength, spring and tooltip colours live in the source.
weight: light: Five images and a single spring tooltip; nothing runs until a pointer enters.
demo: Prompt 'Hover over the avatars' with five portraits: Sarah Chen, Marcus Johnson, Priya Patel and two others.
issues: Tooltips on the end avatars spill past the row, and in frames 2 and 4 they sit over the prompt text.
polishWhy: Crisp avatar row and a playful cursor-tilted card; end tooltips overhang their neighbours.
